pin_added.question: I put agent-written prose above every number. Reasoning: at 07:35 on a phone the first screenful IS the product, so it should be synthesis, not a market recap people can get anywhere. The cost: the first thing your PMs read every single morning is model-written text, unreviewed. Is that the right thing above the fold, or do you want hard numbers first and prose further down where it can do less damage?

Promotion means removal - I stripped NVDA's line out of Holdings News because it is already at the top, so the sheet never says the same thing twice. But if people scan that section as a checklist and expect every held name to appear, a missing NVDA reads as a bug rather than as an editorial choice. Which is it?
